name: fmp_key_metrics
description:
Financial ratios for one company from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/ratios): valuation (PE, PB, PS, EV/EBITDA), returns (ROE, ROA), liquidity, leverage (debt/equity), dividend yield and margins, per period.
Returns {symbol, period, ratios}: ratios is the list of FMP period records.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased), period (annual or quarter; default annual), limit (integer 1-100, number of periods; default 5).
For the raw statements use fmp_income_statement, fmp_balance_sheet, fmp_cash_flow; for growth rates fmp_financial_growth; for a single health score fmp_financial_score.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "period": "annual", "limit": 5}

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL)
